summary.content:
I’m an AI Solutions Engineer, been working at a small AI startup for the past year and a half.

Although I primarily worked on solutions surrounding ML pipelines, I’m very adaptable.

roles.description:
• Enabling dev teams into becoming agentic.

  • Contributing to the development of graph knowledge stores in agentic workflows.

  • Creating AI Workshops for the technology branche of a banking institution.

• RAG & Ingestion Optimization: Reengineered document ingestion pipelines (structured extraction, anonymization, embedding) and fine-tuned context-pruning models, significantly boosting retrieval quality and relevance.

  • Workflow Automation & Agent Prototyping: Built custom n8n nodes, AI automation agents, and internal API integrations to accelerate rapid prototyping and automate client use cases using function calling.

  • SDK & Platform Tooling: Co-developed the platform’s Python SDK and automation scripts, streamlining platform accessibility and developer integration.

• Engineered a Neo4j graph database representation for the in-house Industry 4.0 Asset Administration Shell (AAS).

  • Configured cluster backups using the OpenShift API for Data Protection (OADP) to secure data integrity.

  • Migrated various in-house projects from Docker to Red Hat OpenShift, in order to streamline testing.

  • Deployed various coding projects from GitLab to our OpenShift cluster, so they can be used in other projects.

items.description:
Bachelor's thesis: Efficient algorithms for checking equivalence of compressed strings

We proposed a polynomial-time algorithm for comparing compressed strings, that leveraged the concept of Context-free Grammars (CFGs) in formal language and computation theory. We skip the whole decompress-and-compress step entirely, checking for equivalence in their compressed representations.

items.name: Agregore Browser
items.description: The Agregore browser is a futuristic, free, and open-source (FOSS) web browser for the decentralized web. It supports state-of-the-art distributed internet protocols such as IPFS and BitTorrent.
